narrative: On the tables. The writing-tables, open, held low. Three phrases in a small hand. Wet light on the page. No face, and no second hand. On the tables. The same leaf. No name, no number, and no title above the three phrases. The pencil rests in the gutter.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the phrases and shut the tables.

entities.name: tables
entities.context: Shown on tables in Brazen tombs
